error.message: Some withdrawals exceed the balance of their account. A withdrawal may take any amount up to the account balance, but the total withdrawn from an account across the whole batch (the top-level transaction and its sub-transactions) must not exceed the balance at the start of the batch. In legacy mode, only withdrawals from sub-transactions count towards that total. The field 'data.excessiveWithdrawals' lists, for each account, the total withdrawn and the balance at the start of the batch.
